notes.title: Recruitment for our first Public Playtest!
notes.content:
We're part of Dice Dimensions, a celebration of games where the roll of the dice takes center stage! The event will showcase more than 50 amazing titles. For this special occasion, we wanted to do our [b]first-ever public playtest[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/a39e94ecef5b73867e800bf0fa7954cebb3cea38.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/19b9410329f58df70b9d6cd65d98afcdda9dec36.png[/img]

We're very excited about this first playtest. It will be the first time we'll see you play YVY on Steam! We're looking for feedback so feel free to share it with us. [b]Join the playtest on the store page[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/3c20667ab2c6ed37dd6fb35da61df0f05a498d70.png[/img]
[h3]What can you find in this playtest?[/h3]
In this playtest, you can experience the story's first chapter and attempt to defeat the chapter's boss in the Blueleaf Forest run. You will meet the main cast of characters, face scout enemies, and have the chance to experiment with various skills and builds.

A run in the playtest may vary from 30 to 60 minutes. Of course, replaying the first chapter is always an option!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/c620204491ec3d9b3c1f57f314d7696dc8c2c003.png[/img]
[h3]Where to share your feedback?[/h3]
We've made a Google form to collect your feedback! It should take around 5 minutes to fill out. So please help us by filling out this form: [url=https://forms.gle/7praarkcwaHWgaZd8][b]Feedback form[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/be4dac535873252609ff957018cca6fd52e85e70.png[/img]
[h3]Come chat with us on Discord![/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/vsxD6n8P8J][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/b179de58911c3ae80270f461b7fb392936338a70.png[/img][/url][url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Firesquid][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/f5587fa419d5105228d86f0544713ccd52f041fe.png[/img][/url]

[h2]But most importantly, aproveita![/h2]
